note: Read-only ledger tools offered to the candidate SLM during S5.1 evaluation. The evaluator only checks whether the model emits the right structured arguments; SQLite aggregation itself belongs to S5.5. No write tool exists. v2 (S5.1-a2) adds `use_when` intent descriptions, the canonical category enum, and explicit argument semantics; v1 supplied names and shapes but no intent-to-tool contract, which is why every candidate collapsed onto the first declared tool.

tools.name: sum_expenses
tools.use_when: The user asks for one money total over a period, optionally for a single category: 'how much did I spend', 'what is the total', 'what did X cost me'.
tools.description: One confirmed expense total in VND for one date range, optionally limited to a single category. Internal transfers and income are excluded.

category.description: One exact category name from this list, whatever language the question used. Omit the argument when the question is not limited to one category.

tools.name: category_totals
tools.use_when: The user asks how spending is split across categories over a period: 'by category', 'breakdown', 'per category', 'where did my money go'.
tools.description: Confirmed expense totals per category in VND for one date range.

tools.name: count_transactions
tools.use_when: The user asks for a number of transactions, not an amount: 'how many transactions', 'how many times', 'how many purchases'.
tools.description: Number of recorded transactions in one date range, with optional category and transaction-type scope.

category.description: One exact category name from this list, whatever language the question used. Omit the argument when the question is not limited to one category.

type.description: Transaction type; pass it only when the question is about one of these kinds. Omit for all types.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.use_when: The user asks to see individual transactions: 'list', 'show me the transactions', 'which ones', 'the last N transactions'.
tools.description: Bounded list of recorded transactions in one date range, newest first, with optional category and transaction-type scope.

category.description: One exact category name from this list, whatever language the question used. Omit the argument when the question is not limited to one category.

type.description: Transaction type; pass it only when the question is about one of these kinds. Omit for all types.

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return; pass the count the user asked for.
